answer: Each identity must answer a beacon-derived challenge with a Wesolowski VDF proof, computed through sequential modular squarings in which each result depends on the last. An attacker can run clones on separate GPUs, but cannot parallelize the squarings within any one chain to shorten its delay. Whether identities are labeled comet or ivory, each requires its own computation, imposing a real time and hardware cost on Sybil creation.
